thought.text: All three Tomcats are up. The WARs are large and still deploying. Let me wait and verify the xPlanBox web apps deploy:

reasoning_content: All three Tomcat instances have started up. Next, let's wait a bit for the WAR files to be deployed (they're large, around 100MB each). I'll check the deployment status of the xPlanBox WARs.

action.command: sleep 150; for t in dienste anwendung api; do echo "=== $t ==="; grep -E "Deployment of web archive|Deployment of web application|SEVERE|ERROR" /opt/tomcat-$t/logs/catalina.out | grep -i "xplan\|SEVERE" | tail -8 | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g'; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "sleep 150; for t in dienste anwendung api; do echo \"=== $t ===\"; grep -E \"Deployment of web archive|Deployment of web application|SEVERE|ERROR\" /opt/tomcat-$t/logs/catalina.out | grep -i \"xplan\\|SEVERE\" | tail -8 | sed 's/\\x1b\\[[0-9;]*m//g'; done", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check xPlanBox WAR deployment status"}
